source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: A negative FETCH literal size marks syntax error and returns true to indicate the last chunk. The caller stores that flag, then checks parser state before normal message completion. When parsing cannot continue, it aborts the download. Generic CreateLiteral instead returns nullptr before allocation. Keep completion signaling distinct from a successful payload; these guards retain atoi and do not establish complete numeric-token validation or a reproduced crash fix.
title: The IMAP literal completion flag remains separate from parser success
